title: Compact both learnings files to the 150-line cap and move the factory lessons to ticfac
description:
Both .tick/learnings.md files are over their stated hard cap of 150 lines: ticks is at 157 after the pwp retro, ticfac at 159.

ticks still carries a 'Cloudflare (cloud/factory)' section — four entries, 18 lines — about code that tick 3r2 moved to ticfac. Those lessons are live and worth keeping, but they describe a subsystem this repository no longer contains, and ticks' own learnings header says cross-repo learnings do not belong there. Moving them brings ticks to about 139 and pushes ticfac to about 177, so ticfac needs a real compaction pass in the same change rather than an append.

This is retro editorial work, deliberately not done inline during the pwp close-out because it is a judgement call about what knowledge is still load-bearing, not a mechanical edit.
acceptance_criteria: Both .tick/learnings.md files are at or under 150 lines; the cloud/factory lessons live in ticfac's file and not in ticks'; no lesson is dropped without a recorded reason
